Q1: What part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) Review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml`, `scripts/review_*.sh`)
B) Orchestrator poller and judges (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `orchestrate*.yml`)
C) Clarify, plan and implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D) Documentation only (`README.md`, `agents.md`, `docs/`)
E) Something else: name the file, workflow or behaviour in your answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What is the specific problem or goal?
Choices:
A) Fix a bug: give the failing run ID, log line or wrong behaviour you saw (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reduce cost or runtime: name the phase and the current versus target figure
C) Make it more reliable: name the failure mode that keeps recurring
D) Add a capability: describe the new behaviour you expect
E) Something else: describe it in your answer
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A named failing run or test now passes, and a regression test covers it (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable figure (cost, duration, failure rate) reaches a stated target
C) The behaviour you described in Q2 can be seen in a new contract test
D) Other: state the acceptance criterion in your answer
